brief: Nasdaq 100 futures are roughly flat (about -0.03% near 29,135) after Thursday's 2.6% Nasdaq drop on AI-spending worries, with Dow futures weaker. The 10-year yield is a few bp higher near 4.95-4.98% after Thursday's sharp fall, VIX is up about 3% near 19.7, and Brent near $113 on Middle East tensions keeps inflation worries alive. Live FX and NQ overnight-range data were unavailable this run, so the dollar, overnight-trend and level factors are scored 0. Key risk is renewed tech de-risking into the 9:45 flash PMIs and 10:00 UMich sentiment, with the Fed in its pre-FOMC blackout.
